::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** June 20th 1865  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS UCLA: collection 100: box 95
:::

Sir,
I am obliged by your letter, but I am afraid that other engagements are likely to prevent my becoming a contributor to the proposed journal—and at any rate I could undertake nothing without fuller information.

Yours faithfully
C M Yonge
